referenceFidelity.findings: Hundreds of green suspended plates, wire lattice, depth variation and front cat negative-space follow IA atrium installation logic. Motif is an interpreted cat silhouette; not the source exact Mona image or kinetic system.

construction.findings: Plate solids have authored thickness; transverse wire segments connect varied depth to hanging lines. Oblique view exposes open center and depth field, reverse retains coherent supports.

readability.findings: At phone size grid reads as floating contribution artwork and central cat-shaped absence; from oblique angles it intentionally becomes more abstract.

motion.findings: Intentionally static environment ensemble; no rig, animation, root motion or gameplay behavior requested.

secondPass.findings: Second front/oblique assessment checked plate rhythm and grid depths against source contact sheet. Solid opaque plates simplify polycarbonate deliberately; no floating plates or unintended large opaque background plane.

userAcceptance.note: User requested production; no artistic acceptance of this specific revision has been given.

limitations: Research-informed modular interpretation; furniture measurements are inferred, not certified as-built specifications.
